questions.question: The seer Hanani told King Asa that God delivered the vast Cushite and Libyan army to him because Asa relied on God. True or false?
Why did the seer Hanani rebuke King Asa of Judah for paying a foreign king for help?

answers.text: Asa relied on Aram and not the LORD
Asa bowed down to the gods of Aram
Asa made the deal on the Sabbath day
